description: Schema for retrieving an inactive VEN cleanup schedule. This represents a schedule that automatically removes VEN workloads that have been inactive for a specified duration. The schedule can be enabled or disabled and can target specific workloads based on label criteria.

href.description: URI for this inactive VEN cleanup schedule

org_id.description: Organization ID this cleanup schedule belongs to

uuid.description: Unique UUID for this cleanup schedule

name.description: Name of the inactive VEN cleanup schedule

inactivity_threshold_in_hours.description: Number of hours of inactivity before VEN is considered for cleanup

enabled.description: Whether this cleanup schedule is enabled

created_at.description: Timestamp when this cleanup schedule was created in UTC timezone in RFC3389 format

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this cleanup schedule was updated in UTC timezone in RFC3389 format

href.description: User who originally created this cleanup schedule
User who last updated this cleanup schedule
